turns.text: Hi, this is ICU Nurse Manager + IP. Unit flagged elevated C.
I'm doing well, thanks! Just focusing on improving our infection control measures. How about you?
I’m not sure about the weather, but it’s always a good day to ensure our patients are safe! What about you?
Are you asking about removing the sporicidal protocol? It's crucial for controlling C. diff rates, but I can help find ways to ease workflow concerns.
